verdict.rationale: Orrick ships self-service web tools: Tech Studio form generators, health-check tools and client portals. Asking whether those tools are reachable through an API is therefore a fair question. The evidence pack documents no public API or programmatic access to any of them, and the forms are described as browser-loaded pages that need functional cookies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
